DIAGNOSIS READY: Meningococcemia.

The clinical picture of a high fever (40.5°C), a seizure, and a rapidly spreading generalized nonpruritic rash in an infant is highly suggestive of meningococcemia, a life-threatening bacterial infection. I need to confirm this immediately.
